messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Dama shi Wanan shugaban yayi magana yace Idan yaci zabe zai kori baki gaba daya acikin kasar shi 🤔🤔🤔

output.original_text: Dama shi Wanan shugaban yayi magana yace Idan yaci zabe zai kori baki gaba daya acikin kasar shi 🤔🤔🤔
output.joy: Dama, na ji wannan shugaban yana da kyakkyawan tsari, yace idan ya ci zabe zai kawo canji mai kyau ga dukkanmu cikin kasar! 🌟
output.sadness: Dama, wannan shugaban ya yi magana, amma yana da alama idan ya ci zabe, zai kori kowa daga kasar, hakan yana da ban tausayi. 😞
output.fear: Dama, wannan shugaban ya yi magana, yana cewa idan ya ci zabe, zai kori kowa daga kasar, wannan yana sa ni jin tsoro. 😨
output.anger: Dama, wannan shugaban na da awulshe, ya yi magana cewa idan ya ci zabe, zai korar dukkanmu daga kasar, ba zan yadda da wannan ba! 🤬
output.surprise: Dama, wannan shugaban ya yi magana, yace idan ya ci zabe zai kori kowa daga kasar, na yi matuqar mamaki da hakan! 😳
output.disgust: Dama, wannan shugaban ya yi magana, wanda ya ce idan ya ci zabe, zai kori kowa daga kasar, hakan yana da zafi, ina jin kyama. 🤢
